page: OVHcloud b3-256 is a general-purpose server powered by an AMD EPYC processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. Storage is provided via a local 400 GB NVMe SSD, and the network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The server runs on a KVM hypervisor and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core capabilities. The server achieves top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, passmark CPU score, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression. Memory performance is also notable, with cached small-block read-only memory bandwidth placing in the top tier, while large-block read and write bandwidths rank in the top 25%. In application-specific tests, the b3-256 demonstrates top-tier performance in software compilation with Clang and ray tracing, alongside strong results in database operations and static web serving. Redis SET operations also reach top-tier levels, executing 131.64 million operations per second.

While multi-threaded and multi-core operations are highly efficient, single-core performance is more moderate, with Geekbench single-core scores and single-threaded compression tests falling into the average category. Additionally, LLM text generation speeds for both 135M and 7B models remain average, though prompt processing speeds are strong. Given the dedicated 64-core architecture and balanced memory-to-CPU ratio, this server is suited for multi-threaded workloads such as software compilation, database hosting, static web serving, and parallelized data processing.
